Ylakiai Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Klaipėda County, Lithuania

Not demolished. Ylakiai was one of the first communities to open a branch of Agudat Yisrael, and thirty of its Jews appeared as named donors to the Agudat Fund in 1913 and 1914. On July 6-7, 1941, the town's roughly 300 Jews were murdered over two days — men shot on the first day, women and children on the second — after armed Lithuanians led groups from the synagogue to this very cemetery and shot them there, burying all in a single large mass grave.
